Method: statute rows string-matched against owner-supplied official 2025 MN Statutes 13.03 text (source_docs/MN_13.03_2025_statutes.txt, history through 2025 c 35 art 5 s 1; art 9 s 1); DPO guidance rows matched against the two owner-supplied DPO pages (Copy Costs, Actual Cost); the one row citing Minn. R. 1205.0300 subp. 4 (delivery) plus currency of 13.03 checked on the live revisor.mn.gov pages 2026-08-21 — live 13.03 is the 2025 edition with no 2026 session law in the history, and 1205.0300 subp. 4 matches verbatim (published electronically July 13, 2007, authority MS s 13.07).
